description: Server endpoint POST /api/users/social-login (provider 'google') in api-node/src/routes/users.ts. Verifies a Google ID token (aud = web OR android client ID) with google-auth-library, upserts the user by email, and returns a session via the EXISTING issueTokens() helper so the shape matches /login (honoring isMobileClient). Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that both clients call this endpoint — build this first.
steps: Install the pinned dependency: run `npm install google-auth-library@<latest-stable> --save-exact` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\google-login-both\4astore-v2\api-node (resolve the current stable version and pin it exactly, no caret). Confirm package.json + package-lock.json updated.

In c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\google-login-both\4astore-v2\api-node\src\routes\users.ts: import { OAuth2Client } from 'google-auth-library' and crypto from 'node:crypto'. Add module-level consts GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID = process.env.GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID || '707085023016-etp7au34rg3cd5eks6cdu0cs0vkj1svn.apps.googleusercontent.com' and GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID = process.env.GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID || '707085023016-pc4gc5271kquti6recqo9juor3p44dn9.apps.googleusercontent.com', and a single `const googleClient = new OAuth2Client()`.

Add a PUBLIC route `router.post('/social-login', ...)` (no requireAuth). Validate body with zod: provider must equal 'google' (if provider is present and not 'google', return fail(res, 'Unsupported provider', 400)); idToken is a non-empty string (else fail 422). Verify: `const ticket = await googleClient.verifyIdToken({ idToken, audience: [GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID] })` inside try/catch; on throw return fail(res, 'Invalid Google token', 401). Read `const p = ticket.getPayload()`; if !p || p.email_verified !== true || !p.email return fail(res, 'Invalid Google token', 401).

Upsert: `let user = await prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { OR: [{ email: p.email }, { recovery_email: p.email }] } })`. If found, `user = await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { last_login: new Date() } })`. If not found, create via a helper createGoogleUser(p) described next.

Helper createGoogleUser(p): derive base username = p.email.split('@')[0] lowercased with non-alphanumerics removed, pad to min length 3 if needed. Derive a non-colliding mobile placeholder from p.sub: `'g' + p.sub.replace(/\D/g,'')` truncated to 15 chars (this cannot match the register regex /^[6-9]\d{9}$/ because it starts with 'g'). password = bcrypt.hashSync(crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('hex'), 10). Create with { name: p.name || base, email: p.email, recovery_email: p.email, recovery_email_verified: true, username: <unique>, mobile: <unique placeholder>, password, role: 'customer', registered_at: new Date(), last_login: new Date() }. Wrap in a retry loop (max 5) that, on a Prisma P2002 unique-constraint error, re-suffixes username (base+N) and mobile (placeholder+N) and retries so it never crashes.

Return the session reusing the existing helper: `const { accessToken, refreshToken } = await issueTokens(res, user, isMobileClient(req) ? 'mobile-app' : undefined); return ok(res, { user: safeUser(user), token: accessToken, ...(isMobileClient(req) ? { refreshToken } : {}) });` — identical shape to /login.

Document the accepted audiences in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\google-login-both\4astore-v2\api-node\.env.example: append a '# ---- Google Sign-In (social login) ----' block with GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID set to the two values above, with a comment that these are the two aud values the server accepts and that client IDs are not secrets (defaults in code; override via env).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` in api-node exits 0 (tsc clean) with the new route and dependency present.
POST /api/users/social-login with { provider:'google', idToken:'<invalid>' } returns HTTP 401 and message 'Invalid Google token'.
POST /api/users/social-login with { provider:'facebook', idToken:'x' } returns HTTP 400 'Unsupported provider'.
The success path calls issueTokens() and returns { user, token } (plus refreshToken only when X-Client:mobile) — same shape as /login.
package.json pins google-auth-library to an exact version (no caret); .env.example documents both GOOGLE_*_CLIENT_ID keys.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\google-login-both\4astore-v2\api-node and confirm it exits 0.

Optional runtime smoke (if a dev DB is available): start `npm run dev`, POST the invalid-token and wrong-provider bodies above with curl/Invoke-RestMethod and confirm 401 / 400 respectively. The gating check is the clean tsc build.
findings: DONE. Endpoint: POST /api/users/social-login (PUBLIC, no requireAuth), mounted under the users router (full path /api/users/social-login). Request body (JSON): { provider?: 'google', idToken: string }. If provider is present and != 'google' -> 400 'Unsupported provider'. If idToken missing/empty -> 422 'A valid Google idToken is required'. Invalid/unverifiable token OR email_verified!=true OR no email -> 401 'Invalid Google token'. Success response is IDENTICAL to /login: { success: true, user, token } and additionally refreshToken ONLY when the request carries header X-Client: mobile (isMobileClient). Access+refresh cookies are set by issueTokens() exactly like /login. Server accepts BOTH Google audiences: web 707085023016-etp7au34rg3cd5eks6cdu0cs0vkj1svn.apps.googleusercontent.com and android 707085023016-pc4gc5271kquti6recqo9juor3p44dn9.apps.googleusercontent.com (overridable via env GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID; both documented in api-node/.env.example). Upsert is by email: matches existing user on email OR recovery_email; otherwise createGoogleUser() makes a customer with a unique username (from the email local-part) and a non-colliding mobile placeholder 'g'+digits(sub) that can never match the register regex /^[6-9]\d{9}$/, retrying up to 5x on Prisma P2002. Dependency pinned EXACTLY: google-auth-library@11.1.0 (no caret) in package.json + package-lock.json. google-auth-library needs outbound HTTPS at verify time to fetch Google certs. Clients (FEAT-002 web / FEAT-003 mobile) must POST a Google ID token here; mobile must send X-Client: mobile to receive refreshToken. BUILD NOTE for other steps: node_modules shipped with a STUB generated Prisma client, so `npm run build` failed with ~84 unrelated 'Untyped function calls' errors until the real client was generated. Fix (run once in api-node, needed because the Prisma engine CDN cert isn't trusted in this env): `$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED='0'; npm run prisma:generate`. After that, api-node `npm run build` exits 0 (verified clean tsc with the new route).
